query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Aggregate and act on personal productivity signals across email, calendar, GitHub, LinkedIn, and SMS; additionally configure SMS receiving/sending and manage calendar access/events.
query_ground_truth.intent: Set up and manage SMS communication settings to send and receive text messages.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Confirm recipient permission/opt-in, validate phone number format, and finalize message text before using CLICKSEND_CREATE_SMS_SEND (prevent unintended/invalid sends).
[Optional (if cost/segment count must be known pre-send)] [Prerequisite]: Estimate segments/price using CLICKSEND_SMS_PRICE_POST (avoid billing surprises).
[Required] [Step]: Send (optionally scheduled) using CLICKSEND_CREATE_SMS_SEND with messages[] containing per-recipient to/body (dispatch SMS).

[Required] [Next Step]: Verify acceptance via CLICKSEND_CREATE_SMS_SEND response by checking queued_count vs blocked_count and messages[*].status; retain each per-message identifier for traceability (avoid false positives).
[Optional (if delivery proof/audit is required)] [Next Step]: Retrieve delivery outcomes using CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_RECEIPTS and/or CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_HISTORY (confirm final status).

[Fallback (if blocked, destination gated, or a scheduled send must be stopped)] [Fallback]: Check sending restrictions using CLICKSEND_USER_COUNTRIES_GET and retry once with CLICKSEND_CREATE_SMS_SEND; if a pending send must be halted use CLICKSEND_DELETE_SMS_CANCEL; if SMS remains undeliverable send an alternate notice using GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL.
known_pitfalls: [CLICKSEND_CREATE_SMS_SEND] Each messages[] item must include both to and body; invalid number formatting can trigger validation failures or blocks.
[CLICKSEND_CREATE_SMS_SEND] message_parts can be >1 for long or non-GSM content, increasing total_price beyond a single-part assumption.
[CLICKSEND_CREATE_SMS_SEND] The response may echo a normalized/altered messages[*].body; don’t use it for exact-text verification.
[CLICKSEND_CREATE_SMS_SEND] HTTP success can still mean queued_count=0 with blocked_count>0; rely on messages[*].status for per-recipient outcome.
[CLICKSEND_USER_COUNTRIES_GET] Some destinations require additional enablement/registration; otherwise sends may be blocked despite a successful API call.

CLICKSEND_CREATE_SMS_SEND.description: Tool to send one or more SMS messages via ClickSend. Use when you need to send SMS messages to recipients. Supports up to 1000 messages per API call and provides detailed status for each message.

to.description: Recipient phone number in international format with country code (e.g., '+61411111111'). Must include the '+' prefix and country code.

body.description: Message content/text to send. Standard message contains only GSM characters (max 160 chars). Unicode message contains characters outside GSM set (max 70 chars).

from.description: Sender identifier - can be a shared number, dedicated number, alpha tag (business name), or your own number. If not provided, uses default sender.

source.description: Message source identifier for tracking purposes (e.g., 'sdk', 'php', 'api').

country.description: Destination country code for automatic country code addition to phone numbers.

list_id.description: Contact list identifier to send messages to contacts from your list. If provided, sends to all contacts in the specified list.

schedule.description: Unix timestamp for scheduled sending. If provided, message will be sent at the specified time instead of immediately.

from_email.description: Sender email address if sending via email-to-SMS.

custom_string.description: Custom reference string for tracking purposes. Can be used to associate the message with your internal systems.

items.description: Data model for a single SMS message.

messages.description: List of SMS messages to send. You can post up to 1000 messages with each API call. Each message must have 'to' and 'body' fields at minimum. The `to` field must be in full international format with '+' and country code (e.g., '+12025551234'). Optional `schedule` field accepts a Unix timestamp (seconds) to delay sending; omit to send immediately. Long or Unicode-heavy `body` values may be split into multiple SMS segments, affecting billing.

CLICKSEND_SMS_PRICE_POST.description: Tool to calculate the price for sending SMS messages without actually sending them. Use when you need to estimate the cost of SMS messages before sending.

to.description: Recipient's phone number in E.164 format (e.g., '+61411111111'). Either 'to' or 'list_id' should be provided.

examples: Test message to calculate SMS price
body.description: The message content being sent. Required.

source.description: Indicates the sending method or platform used (e.g., 'api', 'sdk', 'php'). Optional.

list_id.description: Contact list ID as alternative to individual recipient number. Optional.

schedule.description: Unix timestamp for delayed delivery; 0 for immediate. Optional.

custom_string.description: Reference identifier returned with replies and delivery reports. Optional.

items.description: Individual SMS message for price calculation.

messages.description: Array of SMS message objects to calculate price for. Required - at least one message.

CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_RECEIPTS.description: Tool to retrieve SMS delivery receipts from your ClickSend account. Use when you need to poll and view SMS delivery status including timestamps, status codes, and error details. Requires a delivery report rule with Action set to POLL in the Dashboard.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Minimum: 1. Default: 1

limit.description: Number of records per page. Minimum: 1. Default: 15
